name: Own Transformer Scheme
benefit: - **Provision for Installing Own Transformer:** Farmers can install transformers at their own expense according to prescribed standards. - **Group Installation Option:** Farmers have the option to install transformers collectively as a group.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a farmer. - The applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh. - The applicant should be willing to install the transformer at their own expense.
